messages.subject: separate scales of facets
parts:
i have a data frame lke this:

d<-data.frame(a=rep(1:3,6),b=rep(1:3,rep(6,3)),c=rnorm(18),d=rnorm(18))

and i am at:

ggplot(aes(x=c,y=d),data=d)+geom_point()+facet_grid(a~b,scales="free")

but i instead of scales="free" i want to specify the scale for each of the horizontal a panels, something like

ggplot(aes(x=c,y=d),data=d)+geom_point()+facet_grid(a~b,scales_a=list(c(-.5,.5),c(-.3,.3),c(-.4,.4)))

which obviously doesn't work...

any help would be greatly appreciated!

-neal

messages.subject: Re: separate scales of facets
parts:
You can use:
my.plot + scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-3,3))
but every x axis would have the sane limits. Thus scales="free_x" sounds better.

Robert
